title: Unit Event — Bout for Beside You

meta.Outline: Kohane has gained confidence and shown everyone a glimmer of her true potential. As happy as An is, she can't shake a growing feeling of unease. Meanwhile, the mysterious man who gave Kohane advice before makes an appearance before the group...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Made it!
Phew. The lunch rush was worse than I thought it would be.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito and Toya said that they'd be late too, so I just hope Kohane isn't too bored...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm guessing she's practicing with Miku and the others. Especially considering how great Kohane's been doing since that last event...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Kohane!
This song sounded great before but sounds even better now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
It's like you've gone from being just Kohane to Super Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. You should sing for MEIKO and the others later. I'm sure they'll be just as surprised.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's my partner for you! You sound awesome today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You really startled me.
Weren't you busy helping out at home?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I was!
But I was told that I could go after things started to die down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
I think Toya and Akito are here now. Look.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, you two.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We heard you singing just now, Kohane. Were you giving Len and Rin a quick demo...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I was telling them about our show the other day and they said that they wanted to hear me sing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were so good just now too, Kohane! You shined throughout that entire song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so jealous of you, An!
I wish I could sing with Kohane as her partner!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I get how you feel, but she's off limits, okay? She's my partner!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair...!
I wanna sing with Kohane too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, I can sing just as well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? What's wrong, Len?
Why are you puffing your chest out all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
You two are so close.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh, no...
Let's get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your voice sounds good.
I feel like your singing has only been improving since that last event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we're not careful, we'll end up being the ones left behind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Aoyagi!
But I have to keep trying my best and doing better if we're really going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Why do I feel this way...?
What's this hazy feeling in my chest...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, focus!
We need to start warming up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's not that!
My mind just wandered there for a second...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Lately, I haven't been able to shake this feeling...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Ever since we performed in “STAY GOLDEN” a second time and managed to win.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane has more confidence in her singing ability, and it's not like things are going bad for us or anything, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was great, you guys!
We really sang a bunch today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we should probably call it a day soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It really does feel good singing with everyone like this. That feeling from earlier is completely gone now too!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (On top of that, Kohane's doing amazing. We just gotta keep this up and...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, can we talk for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...!
I knew I'd find you guys here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Well, it's about Arata Tono. Remember how your guys' battle ended in a draw...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He's doing a battle event right now and just agreed to do a battle against some old guy from the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was hoping that I'd put at least a dent in you by now...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: But you're gonna need to hit me with a lot more than that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, the crowd's going nuts...!
You could hear them from outside, but I wasn't expecting this at all!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That's the guy I was talking about. There's no way he's just some dude off the street.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, Akito, what's wrong? Do you know him or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He's the one who gave me advice that time...?!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Alright, ready for the next song?
That is, if you're up to it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If I'm going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I need to at the very least be able to overcome you.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Hah!
You've got moxie. I'll give you that!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Anyway, let's keep going while you're still motivated too.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Same rules as before. We'll take turns singing and see who can get the crowd going the most. Sound good?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Kohane! Toya!
Listen closely and don't miss a second of it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Honestly, I don't think they'll be forgetting what they're about to hear anytime soon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Just listening to this is making my heart race...!!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're kidding... This is what we're up against...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(My fingers...
I must've curled them up subconsciously somewhere along the way.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Is this performance having that much of an effect on me...?)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Is that supposed to be a compliment...?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: From my point of view, all of you guys... Sorry, you're still just a newbie when it comes to singing...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That's not who I am anymore...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Arata...
If you're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND, keep this one thing in mind.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Once you understand what that means, you'll be ready...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't know he could sing like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I do. He was the one who told me about committing to myself more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, Akito, who is he exactly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He used to be my dad's partner and helped put on RAD WEEKEND... Or rather, he's part of why it became such a legendary night...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I didn't realize he was back...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Wait, you don't know?!
RAD WEEKEND happened because...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Okay, time to get out of here before they get wise about...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Uncle?
The only one who calls me that is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure is!
It's good to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Look at you! All grown up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course I am.
I'm in high school now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But no one said anything about you coming back! You could've at least popped in for a visit.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry, I promised an old buddy of mine that I'd visit their live house and had to take care of some other stuff too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, how about you come over now? I'm sure Dad would be ecstatic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, lemme introduce you to my team!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You mean, Vivid BAD SQUAD?
I've actually already heard you guys perform.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You have? Like at an event?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. Looks like you've been hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Your teammates don't seem like slouches either.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for giving me that advice the other day...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was able to realize something really important because of it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to thank me!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But your performance the other day was pretty good...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, An, can we head over now? I might have to ask Ken to make me some of his coffee too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Everything I know about Taiga has to do with his stage performances...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That includes a rumor about how he and Ken split after having a huge fight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?
Oh, right... I remember that rumor floating around too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: People were saying that Taiga left right after RAD WEEKEND because of that too. You know anything about that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They're just rumors, right?
I mean, as far as I know, they fought so much because they knew each other so well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But it is true that he went overseas right after that...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Did something really happen between him and Dad...?)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, time to finally greet that jerk after all this time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You've got a lot of nerve coming here.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Priceless!!
That was like something you see in the movies!!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, that's something you always used to say. I just played along.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You know me all too well, partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Looks like they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly seems that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, they really had me going there for a second...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's sit down!
It's time I formally introduced you all to him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Would that be okay, Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sure. I'll be happy to oblige you, An. Your father's a bit of a different story.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's what you're going with after all this time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, lemme start introducing everyone to you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, I'll introduce Uncle Taiga to all of you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito, you already know who he is because of RAD WEEKEND, but Kohane and Toya are still sort of in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Right.
All you gotta do, An, is tell them how great I am!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Wait, you haven't had any yet, have you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Again, Uncle Taiga helped put on RAD WEEKEND and also performed in it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you know, “made it” might be a better way to put it since he helped get the word out...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, we had a lot going on then, but we really wanted to get everyone worth their salt and put on an event with them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And after that, you went to the United States to sing, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, remember that song I told you about? The one by “WALKER”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, a world-famous artist.
Their music videos are very popular online...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad.
But we're still far from the top.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what were you doing singing at that live house today?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The owner's an old friend and I went over to see them. I just happened to run into Arata there.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Considering how I always wear sunglasses and probably don't look the way I used to, he spotted me pretty quickly...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And he said he wanted to battle, so I ended up singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. You haven't changed at all!
Never one to back down from a challenge, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Luckily, Nagi was usually there to keep you out of trouble...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
By the way, how is Nagi?
She went over to the U.S. with you, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Nagi Kotaki. She's Uncle Taiga's little sister.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She, Uncle Taiga and Dad used to be on the same team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they performed in RAD WEEKEND together too. I'll probably never forget the way they all sang.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Her voice was unbelievable too!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, she's good. Still the same...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She's probably doing a street show right now.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What about you guys? How have things been...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Is it still your goal to surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I guess anyone would feel a little anxious after seeing that performance...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Based on that, no person in their right mind should be able to reply to a question like that so fast...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're definitely going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I guess you just gotta be tough sometimes.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hah hah hah!! You haven't changed at all either, An!!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You said so before too.
About surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: To be honest, I was completely overwhelmed by your performance and the thought of how RAD WEEKEND must've been full of unbelievable singers...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still believe that we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You talked to her about that the other day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still sort of can't believe that you were the one she was talking about, Uncle Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, the way she sang really caught my attention.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It did...?!
Well, that's because Kohane's an amazing singer! It's hard not to pay attention to her, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Again, thank you very much for that time! I was able to realize something really important because of your advice during our last event.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You said that you wanted to get better. Do you still feel the same way?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I still want to get better at singing!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, wanna give it a try with me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-What do you mean?
You're not planning on...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Relax, An.
I'm not trying to take her away from you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: From what I understand, your friend here wants to catch up to you guys as quickly as she can, An.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And I'm curious to find out just how far she can go if she's given that chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (A lot of people have asked Uncle Taiga to teach them how to sing, but he always turned them down...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I actually stopped practicing on my own to focus more on working together as a team.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Okay. Well, I'll be around for a little while longer if you ever change your mind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, I should probably get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Like I said, I've got other stuff to take care of.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You really haven't changed one bit.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Just enjoying my fifteen minutes.
Anyway, Ken, thanks for having me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm guessing he asked you because of what he saw during that last event, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Azusawa's performance was spectacular, to say the least.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But the Taiga Kotaki chose you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't sound scared. He essentially went out of his way to tell you that you're worthy of being taught. You should be more proud.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But are you really going to turn him down, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, practicing as a team is definitely important, but he's a legend. There's no telling when you'll have another chance like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He said that he's going to be around for a while, but who knows how long that is? You should still probably ask him for one lesson.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right...
Plus, our next event is coming up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What do you think?
Should I try asking him...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(No, it's happening again...
That feeling in my chest is getting worse...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you know that he almost never takes students?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I even asked him a long time ago and he just made some excuse about me being too young.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You might not get this chance again, so I say go for it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And he gave you some good advice once already, right? I wish he'd do that for me♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm with her on this. If this means you getting better, then we'll become better as a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It'll be an opportunity to take a step forward towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND via someone who was responsible for it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're right, all of you...
Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to get lots of new tips from him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great! I know you will, girl!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Lights are off and...
Dad, I just flipped the sign to “Closed”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Now, let's start cleaning up.
I'll get the chairs and...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And I'm curious to find out just how far she can go if she's given that chance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to get lots of new tips from him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, it's only gotten worse since then...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You seemed concerned.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't put my finger on it, but my mind's been so hazy lately. It's like I don't know what I want to do...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's so hard to explain, but I have a really bad feeling about it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She was so good during our last event. Like really good. Enough to surprise even you, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I was so happy for her too. It's like she's finally become confident about herself, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This hazy feeling just keeps growing inside me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And even today, when Uncle Taiga asked Kohane about practicing together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone's been showering Kohane with praise since that event, including Uncle Taiga, but he wouldn't teach me how to sing when I asked him to!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So maybe I'm jealous of her... Like, “Why her?” you know?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is that how you actually feel...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well...
I tried saying it, but it didn't seem like the right answer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hate to lose, but I usually take a more positive approach to think and work harder to do better next time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'm genuinely happy about how everyone loves the way Kohane sings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because she's really the best and just listening to her makes my heart race...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You mean every word of that too, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I used to be just like you...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I couldn't help, but smile after hearing the way Taiga sang.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? You've never told me that before!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Because it never really came up.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Which made forming a team with him all the more difficult.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: He could do something others only dreamed about. I was constantly worried about being left behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, Dad, you went through a phase like that too?! I kinda can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was always under the impression that nothing really bothered you since you always seem to be at ease...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You're sort of right...
What you say may've been the case if I never met Taiga and formed a team with him.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Could it be that you're going through the same thing...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is that how you feel about her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You mean if I'm worried about Kohane leaving me behind...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
Kohane's definitely been improving, but...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: For now, you may want to take a good, hard look at yourself...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll clean up the kitchen, so you can go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's messaging me directly? Not to our group chat? Lemme see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: <We need to talk tomorrow before practice. Try to be there early.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, can we talk for a minute?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What does he want to talk about...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But why would Akito ask to meet here instead of at the park?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, you're already here!
You must've gotten here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something's been bothering you lately. Enough to make you look sad or worried.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You knew, huh...?
About this thing I've been feeling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't completely obvious or anything, and my guess is that Toya still doesn't know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good.
I'd really hate to be the one that brings our team's mood down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Lately, whenever I start thinking about Kohane, this hazy feeling begins welling up inside my chest.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And this all started after what she did during the last event...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look, I don't know about you, but lately, every time I've heard her sing, it motivates me to push myself even harder...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I seriously doubt anyone knows just how high her ceiling is. It might even be infinite.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's having an effect on the rest of us, including me, which means you, her partner, probably have it worse...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You feel like you're getting left behind... Like I did a while ago...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now I see. You were worried about me. Thanks, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, my dad asked me the same thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About feeling like I'm getting left behind by Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't deny that fact. I'd be lying if I did...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this doesn't seem like the whole picture. I feel like there's more to this than just that...
Alright, let's make practice really count today! And please listen more carefully this time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? Hey, Akito, An!
Is it just you two here today? That's pretty rare...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uh, yeah...
We were just having a discussion about something and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What were you two doing?
Were you about to start practicing or something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember how Rin said that she wanted to partner up with Kohane to sing with her? That seems to have sparked something inside Len.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You wanted Rin to say your name instead of Kohane's, right...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, you're right!
I'm her partner! Imagine how I felt when she said that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...!
You don't have to worry so much, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you mean?! Of course, I'm gonna worry! How would you feel if you were in my shoes, An?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What if Kohane said, “I want to sing with someone else”...? How would that make you feel?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's like you're not going to be partners anymore.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? Is something wrong, An?
You don't look so good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sorry, Len...
Mind if we postpone practice until tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to talk to An and Akito about.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nooo!
You promised to help me out today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I will, tomorrow.
Also, next time we're at MEIKO's place, you can get whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
O-Okay, if you insist...
Tomorrow for sure! Promise, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I promise.
See you tomorrow, Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For a little while now, I've noticed that you've been acting a little differently, An.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it was very subtle, so it took me some time to confirm my suspicions.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm worried that one day, Kohane's not going to want to be my partner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think that's really what's bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You think Kohane's not gonna want to be your partner...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know for certain that Kohane wants to be my partner and won't just leave like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But for some reason, a part of me has been so confused lately...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She just keeps getting better and better, while whatever I'm feeling keeps getting worse and worse.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, An...?
Can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you want to be to Kohane?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I... I want to be the best partner I can for Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When I heard her sing that day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane even told me that she felt the same way after hearing me sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was so happy when she said that, and made my decision right there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That she's the only one who can be my partner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's my first partner and I care about her a lot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to care for her more than anyone else... I want to be someone she can respect and be proud of...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That very well may be it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since you want to be someone she can “respect and be proud of”, An, you want her to like and be excited by the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're worried about not being able to do that if Kohane keeps improving at her current rate, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Kohane's so amazing...
I want to tell her that she did awesome...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But why? Why is it that I can't get myself to just tell her that...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As happy as I was about how awesome Kohane sang, a part of me felt so much anxiety over it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if Kohane becomes so good that I'm not able to hold a candle to her anymore...? That question flashed across my mind after her performance...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really don't like where my mind's been wandering...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially since Kohane decided to chase after the same dream as me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me feeling this way is like...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think it's only natural for you to feel this way...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sang all by yourself until just recently, right...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is it true that you just did your first event?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're still just getting started, but yeah, this was an important first step for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We definitely need to practice more and work on staying in sync.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And I'm sure you'll do just fine if you keep at it. For now, have a seat and relax.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Akito!
It's like you're one of the regulars now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Shiraishi. Yeah, I'm back again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And who might this be, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ken's... Yes, I see.
I need to give you a proper greeting then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, this guy next to you... Is he...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's my partner.
We decided to form a team together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My name is Toya Aoyagi.
It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice to meet you too! I'm An Shiraishi! And we're all friends here so you don't have to be all formal with me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So you finally found a good partner, huh? You did say that you've been wanting to form a team like Dad's...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and that might actually be possible with Toya here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great!
A partner, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, more customers!
Sorry, I should probably get back to work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sit back, relax and have fun, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is she a singer too, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and no one our age comes close to her level. Some professional musicians have even begun keeping an eye on her...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?
Then, it'd be nice to hear how she is sometime.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is she not on a team?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nope... She says she's looking for one and a bunch of people have already asked her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It'd be great if she can find someone she respects and respects her back, but that's easier said than done.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It might even be next to impossible at her level...)

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: Have you found a good partner yet, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, not yet...
It's taking longer than I expected...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that we're gonna be singing together forever once I do!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll practice a bunch and do a lot of performances together, while maybe having a few fights along the way...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And then, we're gonna put on an event that's so good, it surpasses Dad's!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane's really the one you were looking for all this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I think it's natural for you to be scared of her not being your partner anymore...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Based on what I know, I seriously doubt that's ever going to happen, but I can't say that possibility's zero...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still don't know what to do about how I feel about all of this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the very least, you want Kohane to keep being your partner, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That means you gotta keep climbing with her. You gotta practice and work hard to keep up with her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We might have to answer some awkward questions if we end up running late.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry if we kept you waiting. We can start warming up now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
We haven't even started yet, so it's all good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be practicing with Taiga tomorrow morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I managed to find Taiga hanging around Vivid Street after that and swapped contact info with him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Good for you, Kohane!
But if he asks you to do anything weird, tell me right away! I'll set him straight if that happens!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Akito, is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's nothing... I was just thinking about our next song.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start warming up.
Ready...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know how I really feel now, but...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hey, An, good morning.
You're up early. You know you have today off, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know...
I couldn't fall back asleep.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Okay, in that case...
How does some French toast sound?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Really?
But you're always telling me to have breakfast at home.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I don't mind doing this every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yay...!
Then, I want extra powdered sugar!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I think Dad's really worried about me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Thanks to them, I was finally able to figure out what's been bothering me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I'm about to start practicing with Taiga! I'm nervous, but promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Dad.
After I'm done eating breakfast, I'm gonna go out and sing all day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So sorry, I won't be able to help out today...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Okay...
As a parent, I'd prefer it if you didn't stay out too late...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you seem pretty determined, so go sing your heart out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last came to Vivid Street to sing.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane and I used to come here to help build her confidence, but now we're just holding team practices at the park.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So that I can keep being Kohane's partner...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Okay, I feel good.
I'm hitting all the high notes.)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Huh? An, are you all alone today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
I decided to do some solo work today!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, cool!
It's been a while since you sang solo like this. It's nice for a change.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? Well, I'm gonna be here all day, so stick around and enjoy the show.

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD's An's great and all, but seeing she's just as awesome flying solo is amazing too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(No, I can do better...
I need to be more patient to give the chorus more of an impact.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll do that for the next one...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Looks like An's singing on her own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Yeah, that was perfect!
But this is what we normally...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Before, I could sing here without having anything bother me and always found a way to have fun.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But now, that feeling's weighing me down...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (At the same time, I never would've felt this way if I kept singing on my own...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was able to discover how I feel because of everyone else... Because I have Kohane now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I just gotta accept it and keep singing...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening, everyone!
My team will be doing another event soon, so be sure to come check us out!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
You're the best, An!
Come sing for us again!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
I love the way An sings!
It's like she knows exactly how to spice up everything!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I think I can finally move forward a little now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That reminds me...
This is where I did my first street performance.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(It's such a nice spot too.
I can sing without worrying about much and people can gather without getting in the way of others.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Talk about a blast from the past. But it also feels like it happened just yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, this is where we're singing...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You want to practice tomorrow too, right? It might be good to call it day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, good work today.
You showed real improvement. I think it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I do. I'm sure Rin will want to sing with you now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I sure hope so...!
Alright, I've gotta keep this up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But for now, wanna head back to MEIKO's place? I'm parched...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mind going ahead without me, Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, but where are you gonna go?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's something I should probably take care of now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, what are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aren't you supposed to be practicing with Uncle Taiga today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I was with him all morning...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we didn't work on singing today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Instead of singing, he told me to take another look at this city, and we spent some time walking around...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I wasn't really sure what he wanted me to see, but it was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It even reminded me of when I first wandered into Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember being so scared at first, but you helped me realize that I was wrong, An. And I'm really happy that you did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And then I heard you singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm still amazed by how cool your voice is! It still makes my heart race every time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to keep practicing, and learn how to be cool and sing like you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like me? But you're already super cool, Kohane! Enough to make my heart race!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
Hehe. Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, I know so. You're super cool, really amazing and always shine on stage...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If we end up being far away from each other, what would you do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If we actually manage to surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, way in the future, if we end up becoming world famous like Uncle Taiga and really make it, but end up apart from each other...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, does this mean you're going somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-No, I'm not going anywhere now! I'm just asking, “What if?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay... Well...
When you become world famous...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even then, I'd still want to sing with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It doesn't matter where you go or what you do, An. I'm pretty sure that I'd want to keep singing with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but that probably won't be easy either since I'd have to keep finding ways to get better...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, I want to keep singing with you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'm gonna keep doing my best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...?
Is everything okay, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Everything's perfect!
Sorry for dropping such a weird question on you like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, since we're here...
Wanna sing something together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We had our first practice together here, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I kinda feel like singing with you now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
Hehe. You really surprised me by just immediately singing that time too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's just the two of us. I can hear Kohane's voice so clearly...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Every time I hear her sing, she makes my heart pound and think that something amazing's about to start.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I absolutely love it. I genuinely love the way she sings...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I might have to deal with this kind of uncertainty again, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (For now, I just gotta keep going!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <She isn't completely out of the woods yet...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But she's decided to face what's bothering her.>
